newsitem.title: USA: ConAgra sees double-digit EPS rise in FY97.
newsitem.headline: ConAgra sees double-digit EPS rise in FY97.

text.p: ConAgra Inc said Thursday it continues to expect double-digit earnings per share growth for fiscal 1997.
It also expects the year to be its 17th consecutive year of record earnings, excluding charges in last year's fourth quarter.
Earlier, it reported third quarter earnings of $0.63 a share, up from $0.55 a year ago.
In fiscal 1996, ConAgra's earnings before charges rose 13.6 percent to $2.34 a share.
For the first nine months of fiscal 1997, ConAgra earned $1.87 a share, up 14.7 percent from $1.63 a year ago.

ConAgra Chairman Philip Fletcher said the company is pleased with results so far this year. "In fact, fiscal '97 has developed very much as expected, including the evident benefit of ConAgra's balanced business base."
ConAgra's sales for the third quarter declined to $5.64 billion from $5.77 billion, while nine-month sales declined to $18.80 billion from $18.84 billion.
ConAgra said that, as expected, third quarter and nine-month sales were reduced by business dispositions and restructuring initiatives.
